sections.name: caseSynthesis
sections.title: Building the nuclear case study summary
sections.what: Creates the dated nuclear delivery case studies (Darlington refurbishment, Flamanville 3 and Hinkley Point C), with quotes and sources, arranged into what failed and what worked, then returns the slides, sources and an answer.
sections.why: Likely reason: a teaching demo needs a stable, reviewed story rather than live model output. The header says the figures do not change the run's numbers.
sections.watch_out: Project names written here must match the names in the scan data, or the citations lose their project link.

summary: Builds a fixed summary of three nuclear project delivery case studies, with dated quotes from public sources, for a guided demo.
purpose: Supplies the text, citations and written answer for the synthesis slides of a guided demo. The content is written in the code, not generated live.
why: The header says the passages were checked on 2026-10-07 and are dated case studies that do not change the run's numbers. Likely reason for fixed text: a repeatable demonstration.
how: The function receives a list of projects, creates source references by matching project names, writes the failure and success points with their citations, pairs one failure of each kind on each page, then returns the synthesis, the source list and a written answer.
inputs: A list of projects, each with an id and name, taken from the scan data.
outputs: An object holding the synthesis for the slides, the list of sources and a plain-text answer.
risks: If a project name is not in the list, its source reference gets an empty project id, with no error. The pairing step assumes two failure groups exist, so a change in the structure would crash it.
debug: If citations show no project link, compare the project names in the input with the names written in this file. If slides are missing findings, check the pairing step near the end of the function.
